nodes.description: Total token supply counter, updated in createTokens via SafeMath.add and read by totalSupply().
Contract owner address, set to msg.sender in the constructor and recipient of ether in createTokens.
Mapping of token holder balances, mutated by createTokens, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Constant conversion rate (500 tokens per wei) used to compute minted tokens.
Constant cap on the total token supply enforced in createTokens.
Payable minting function: requires msg.value > 0, mints msg.value * RATE tokens, updates balances and _totalSupply, then sends msg.value to owner.
Payable fallback function that forwards to createTokens().
Constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
ERC20 transfer: validates sender balance and moves tokens between balances.
ERC20 transferFrom: validates allowance and balance then moves tokens; contains a wrong-variable subtraction on balances[msg.sender].
ERC20 approve: sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Constant function returning balances[_owner].
Constant function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Constant function returning _totalSupply.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, minter, sender and allowance holder.
External ETH transfer to owner inside createTokens; reachable from the payable fallback, external call surface.
Defective update in transferFrom: debits balances[msg.sender] instead of balances[_from], corrupting accounting.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Recipient parameter of transfer.
Source parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Spender parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Address parameter of balanceOf.
Owner address parameter of allowance.
Spender address parameter of allowance.
Local variable in createTokens holding msg.value.mul(RATE).
Reentrancy surface: recipient of owner.transfer could re-enter the payable fallback/createTokens.

edges.reason: msg.sender selects the balances mapping slot credited in createTokens.
msg.sender is used by createTokens to key balance updates.
Constructor sets the privileged owner state variable directly from untrusted msg.sender.
transfer uses msg.sender to read and write the sender balance.
transferFrom uses msg.sender both in the allowance check and in the flawed balance debit.
approve keys the allowance by msg.sender.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping inside approve.
Constructor writes unbounded caller-controlled address into the owner state variable.
createTokens performs an external ETH transfer to owner after mutating balances and _totalSupply.
owner state variable supplies the destination of the external transfer.
createTokens increases _totalSupply with SafeMath.add, with overflow risk on the supply counter.
createTokens credits balances[msg.sender] using SafeMath.add.
Computed tokens local is added into _totalSupply.
Computed tokens local is added into the caller balance.
RATE constant multiplies msg.value to derive the tokens local.
maxTokens caps the minted supply check inside createTokens.
Payable fallback unconditionally routes execution into createTokens.
transfer performs SafeMath.sub and SafeMath.add on the balances mapping.
transferFrom performs unchecked-variable arithmetic on the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender] with SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom reaches the defective debit statement that subtracts from balances[msg.sender].
Defective statement writes the balances mapping with the wrong address key.
approve writes the allowed mapping for the caller/spender pair.
transfer destination parameter indexes the credited balances slot.
User-supplied amount drives SafeMath.sub/add inside transfer.
transferFrom source parameter is validated against allowance and balance.
transferFrom recipient parameter is used for the credit side of the transfer.
User-supplied amount drives subtraction in transferFrom.
approve spender parameter keys the allowed mapping.
approve amount parameter is written verbatim into allowed.
balanceOf address parameter selects the returned balance.
allowance owner parameter selects the returned allowance.
allowance spender parameter selects the returned allowance.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
External ETH transfer to owner can fall back into the payable createTokens/fallback path before the transaction completes.
Potential re-entry into createTokens through the ether-receiving owner address.
